name: reliability
description: Reliability for a repository: availability targets per service checked against their dependencies, SLOs with burn-rate alerts and an error-budget policy, incident runs, blameless postmortems, a static status page from published records, on-call rules, a backup inventory with restore tests and a restore-test runbook, a change record on each server with an AGENTS banner on every ssh connection, and gate checks on the service catalogue and the backup inventory.
